Mechatronics Engineer · Ankara, Türkiye & Abu Dhabi, UAE

Naser Taha

I build robots that move on their own and the software and electronics that run them. My work covers ROS 2 navigation, embedded controllers, custom PCBs and ground control software for drones.

Open to full-time roles in robotics, automation and embedded systems

about

From breadboard to working robot

I graduated in Mechatronics Engineering from Atılım University in 2026. I like projects where mechanical, electrical and software parts have to work together, and I take a prototype all the way from a breadboard circuit to a custom board.

My hands-on experience includes ROS 2 and Nav2 on a campus delivery robot, a Qt and MAVROS ground control station for a UAV, and fault diagnosis on real vehicles. I am looking for engineering work where I can keep building practical systems with real-world value.

experience

Internships

Jul – Aug 2024

Intern Engineer, Automotive Mechatronics

Alkhtabout Garage · Al Ain, UAE

  • Diagnosed and repaired multi-discipline vehicle faults across mechanical hardware, wiring harnesses and onboard software.
  • Analysed telemetry and OBD-II data to isolate CAN bus communication errors and test electronic sensors.
  • Carried out Engine Control Unit reprogramming.
  • Maintained powertrains and electromechanical subsystems, managing repairs from first fault detection to final software validation.

Aug – Sep 2026

Intern Engineer

Pavo Group, Istanbul Defence Systems · Ankara, Türkiye

  • Built G-PilotGUI, a custom ground control station for real-time monitoring and safe control of a physical UAV, using C++17, Qt, ROS 2 Jazzy, MAVROS and MAVLink.
  • Designed a multithreaded ROS 2 and Qt architecture so telemetry processing stays responsive.
  • Added live GPS positioning, a Leaflet.js map with flight-path tracking, attitude and heading display, battery and velocity monitoring, and custom flight instruments.
  • Integrated a Thrustmaster joystick for manual flight control, with axis scaling and flight-mode commands.
  • Added PWM and actuator output monitoring so control signals can be verified without powering the motors.
  • Resolved ROS 2 QoS, quaternion-to-Euler conversion, ENU-to-compass heading and serial communication issues, which produced a working standalone UAV monitoring and control platform.
